name: tp-voyager-observability
description: Show TP-Voyager delegated Crew presence and execution trace inside the current Codex conversation.

interface.shortDescription: See delegated Crew activity in Codex
interface.longDescription: Shows TP-Voyager Crew status, model, assistant output, tool/file activity, usage, and terminal result in the current conversation through the existing TP-Voyager MCP server.
defaultPrompt: Use TP-Voyager to delegate a bounded task and keep the Agent panel visible while it runs.
